decisions.evidence: The original Definition calls m the r^-1 coefficient of V while V=r-2m+V_(1)/r+O(r^-2); that coefficient is V_(1). Replaced only the contradictory clause by m=-1/2 lim(V-r), matching Mädler–Winicour §3 Eqs. (38),(57). Checked all direct/reference consumers, all within batch 33; they already use this convention and need no edits. Manifest and live quotations synchronized; original observations retained.

decisions.evidence: The detector Statement specifies u,r,C,H and lambda units but omits units for separation and derivatives. Added length units for s0, delta s, s_lambda and J_lambda, dimensionless first u derivatives and inverse-length second derivatives. This agrees with the formal Jacobi forcing and quantitative bounds, including the distinct constants in proof 4.1. The sole consumer ex-gr-fx05-1 inherits these conventions and needs no repair.
